business_summary: Polyrocks Chemical Co.,LTD, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of chemical raw materials and new chemical materials in China and internationally. The company offers halogen-free flame retardants, phosphorus chemicals, and petroleum additives; modified plastic particles and plastic products; LPG products; modified plastic wires and cables; ink products; polystyrene products; chemical fibers; boards; automotive profiles and panels; diffuser and light guide plates; reflective sheets; plastic additives; and electrical machinery and equipment. It also provides film and breathable film materials, optical panel materials, and adhesive resins; petrochemical feedstocks; cosmetic oils and waxes, graphene, and pharmaceutical active ingredients; biodegradable materials, eco-friendly hygiene and packaging solutions, and material solutions; EPP foam materials, smart reusable transport solutions, and construction modules; and perovskite solar cells, 3D printing materials, dianhydride monomers, LCD photoresist, fireproof coatings, and anion exchange membranes. In addition, the company engages in waste plastic recycling and disposal; supply chain management; cargo packing; construction and installation; wholesale and trading; investment; technology promotion and application; sale of sanitary materials and products; technical consulting; artificial intelligence software services; new materials technology research, development, and promotion; and leasing services for modular scaffolding systems. The company serves the festive lighting, automotive, new energy batteries, home appliances, optical displays, and specialty chemicals industries. It exports its products. The company was formerly known as SPS (Guangzhou) Ltd. Polyrocks Chemical Co.,LTD was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Qingyuan, China.
business_summary_ko: Polyrocks Chemical Co.,LTD는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 국제적으로 화학 원료 및 신규 화학 물질의 연구, 개발, 생산 및 판매에 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 무할로겐 난연제, 인계 화학물질, 석유 첨가제를 제공합니다. 변형된 플라스틱 입자 및 플라스틱 제품; LPG 제품; 수정된 플라스틱 전선 및 케이블; 잉크제품; 폴리스티렌 제품; 화학섬유; 무대; 자동차 프로필 및 패널; 확산판 및 도광판; 반사 시트; 플라스틱 첨가제; 전기 기계 및 장비. 또한 필름 및 통기성 필름 소재, 광학 패널 소재, 접착 수지 등을 제공합니다. 석유화학 공급원료; 화장품 오일 및 왁스, 그래핀 및 제약 활성 성분; 생분해성 소재, 친환경 위생 및 포장 솔루션, 소재 솔루션; EPP 폼 소재, 스마트 재사용 가능한 운송 솔루션 및 건설 모듈; 페로브스카이트 태양전지, 3D 프린팅 소재, 이무수물 모노머, LCD 포토레지스트, 내화코팅, 음이온교환막 등이 있다. 또한 회사는 폐플라스틱 재활용 및 처리 업무도 담당하고 있습니다. 공급채널
